description: This Java source file defines a custom Jackson adapter for the ExternalId class, providing serialization and deserialization logic for ExternalId objects to and from JSON.

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to create Jackson modules for ExternalId serialization/deserialization, including inner classes for Serializer and Deserializer.

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter.Serializer
classes.description: A Jackson JsonSerializer for ExternalId objects, serializing them to their string value or null.

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter.Deserializer
classes.description: A Jackson JsonDeserializer for ExternalId objects, deserializing from string values or null.

methods.name: createModule
methods.description: Creates and returns a Jackson SimpleModule configured with the ExternalId serializer and deserializer.
